book.name: Luk
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Luk Le Rorori

content: Judas i vatomwe Jisas
Mbaŋa vama i ghenetha, kaero Bred ma weiye isɨt ghathaga, idae regha Thaga Valaŋani.
Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye na mbaro gharavavaghare thɨ mararuŋgiya gharɨgharɨ iya kaiwae thɨ vakatha thuwele kamwathɨ na thɨ vakatha Jisas na i mare.
Seitan i ru weya Judas
Amba Seitan i ru weya Judas, thɨ uno Isakariyot, iye ghalɨŋae gharaghambuko theyaworo na theghewoko regha.
Judas i wa na ve utu weiyaŋgiya ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye na Ŋgolo Boboma gharagatɨgatɨ lenji randevivaŋgi na i utuŋa ŋgoroŋga ne iŋa na i vatomwe Jisas weŋgi.
Thɨ warariŋa le renuwaŋako na thɨ dagerawe modae kaiwae.
Judas i varae na i tamweya kamwathɨ thovuye moli na i vaŋgugiya weŋgi mbala thava gharɨgharɨko wolaghɨye thɨ ghareghare.
Jisas na gharaghambu thɨ ghanaThaga Valaŋani ghanɨŋganiye
Mbaŋa iviva moli Bred ma weiye Isɨt ghambaŋa, mbaŋaniye thɨ gaboŋgiya sip nariye Thaga Valaŋani ghanɨŋganiye kaiwae.
Jisas i variyeŋgiya Pita na Jon na i dage weŋgi, iŋa, “Hu wa na vohu vivatharaweya Thaga Valaŋani ghanɨŋganiye kaiwanda na mbala ra ghan.”
Thɨ vaito thɨŋa, “Nuwaniya aŋga wo wa na vo vivatharawe ghanɨŋgakowe?”
I gonjogha weŋgi, iŋa, “Mbaŋa ne hu ru e ghembana tɨne, amala regha i thɨna mbwa variye, ne i lavolevoleŋga. Hu mbele na vohu ru e ŋgolona iya ve runawe
na hu dage weya ŋgolona tanuwagae huŋa, ‘Ravavaghare i vaito: Iyaŋganiya woluwolu bobwari kaiwaŋgu na ne ya ghana Thaga Valaŋani ghanɨŋganiye weiŋguyaŋgiya woraghambuke?’
Ne i vatomwe woluwolu laghɨye regha ina e toutou. Ghanɨŋga bigibiginiye kaero inanjiwe, na gheko vo hu vakatharawa bigibigina wolaghɨyewe.”
Thɨ wa na vethɨ vaidi ŋgoreiya me dagema weŋgi, na thɨ vivatharaweya Thaga Valaŋanima ghanɨŋganiyewe.
Thaga Valaŋani ghanɨŋganiye
Mbaŋa ghanɨŋga ghambaŋa i yaku weiyaŋgiya ghalɨŋae gharaghambɨ na thiya ghanɨŋga.
I dage weŋgi, iŋa, “Nuwaŋguke nuwaiya moli ya ghana Thaga Valaŋani ghanɨŋganiyeke iyake weiŋguyaŋgiya ghemi amba muyai ya vaidiya vuyowo.
Kaiwae ya dage e ghemi, ma tene mbaŋa reghava ya ghan Thaga Valaŋa ghanɨŋganiye ghaghada ne ghambaŋa emunjoru moli i yomara mbaŋa Loi le ghamba mbaro ne i mena.”
Amba Jisas i thɨna kom, i vata ago weya Loi, na iŋa, “Hu thɨna iyake na hu mun taulaghɨna ghemi.
Ya dage e ghemi, ma tene ya munɨva waenɨke iyake, ghaghada Loi le ghamba mbaro ne i mena.”
Amba i wo bred mbumbura, i vata ago weya Loi, i mwanaviya na i giya weŋgi gharaghambuma iŋa, “Iyake riwaŋgu, ya vatomwe ghemi kaiwami. Hu vakatha valaŋa iyake wo renuwaŋakiki kaiwae.”
Na tembe ŋgoreiyeva, ghanɨŋga e ghereiye i thɨna komuma na i thɨnɨgiya weŋgi, na iŋa, “Waenɨke iyake madɨbaŋgu iya i vaemunjoruŋa dagerawe togha. I voruraŋgi ghemi kaiwami.
Ko iyemaeŋge wo hu thuwe, thela iya wo lilivako, iye ina e ghanɨŋgake iyake tɨne.
Kaiwae Lolo Nariye ne i mare ŋgoreiya Loi le renuwaŋa, ko iyemaeŋge vuyowo laghɨye moli ne i wa weya loloko iya ne i vatomweko!”
Gharaghambu thɨ vevaitoŋgi thɨŋa, “Thela ina e tɨnendake ne i vakatha kamwathɨko iyako?”
Thela i laghɨye moli?
Gharaghambu mbe thiye eŋge thɨ wogaithɨ thela i laghɨye moli e tɨnenjiko.
Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Thiye ma Jiu gharɨgharɨniye lenji kiŋ thɨ mbaroŋaŋgi e vurɨgheghe laghɨye na ghanjimberegha thɨ wovoreŋaŋgi na thɨ uno idanji ‘Gharɨgharɨ ghanjirathalavu’.
Ko e ghemi ma ŋgoreiyako, iyemaeŋge thela iye i laghɨye moli e tɨnemina, valɨkaiwae iye ŋgoreiya lolo tabwagha moli i gharenja, na randeviva iye ŋgoreiya rakakaiwo.

Thela i laghɨye moli, loloko iya i yaku e ghamba ghanɨŋga na i ghanɨŋgako o loloko iya i kaiwo kaiwaeko?” “Ŋgoreiye, e yambaneke lenji renuwaŋa tɨne loloko iya i yakuko. Ko iyemaeŋge ghino e tɨnemina lemi rakakaiwo.”
“Ghemi vambe weiŋguyaŋgi vara ghemi e wovuyowoke wolaghɨye tɨnenji;
na ŋgoreiye Bwebwe va i vatomwe e ghino na ya mbaro ŋgoreiye kiŋ, ghino tembe ŋgoreiyeva ya vatomwe e ghemi na hu mbaro.
Iya kaiwae ne hu yaku elo ghamba ghanɨŋga na hu ghanɨŋga na hu munumu elo ghamba mbaro tɨne, na ne hu yaku e ghamba yaku thovuthovuye na hu mbaroŋaŋgiya uu theyaworo na theghewo Isirel e tɨne.”
Jisas iŋa Pita ne iŋa ma i ghareghareŋgo
Jisas iŋa, “Saimon, Saimon! Wo u vandeŋe! Loi kaero va i vatomwe weya Seitan na ne i mandoŋga i ghathaŋga ŋgoreiya uma gharakakaiwo i ghatha wit mbombouye weiye varivariye.
Ko iyemaeŋge kaero ya naŋgo Saimon ghen kaiwan mbala len loŋweghathɨna ma i dobu, na mbaŋa u numonjogha e ghino, amba u vavurɨghegheŋaŋgiya oghaghana.”
Pita i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Giyana, ya vatomweŋgo na weiŋgu ghen e thiyo na ya mare weiŋgu ghen.”
Jisas i gonjoghawe, iŋa, “Ya dage e ghen, Pita, kamkam mane amba i kula gougouke noroke, ghaghad ne mbaŋato uŋa ma u ghareghareŋgo.”
Jisas i vanuwovɨrɨŋgiya gharaghambu

Amba Jisas i vaitoŋgiya gharaghambu, iŋa, “Mbaŋa va ya variyeŋga na hu rakaraŋgi, va e mbaŋako iyako mava e lemi vethe nasiye, ma e lemi nambo na ma e gheghemi ghae, thare va bigi reghava i kwara e ghemi?” Thɨ gonjoghawe, thɨŋa, “Nandere moli.”
I dage weŋgi iŋa, “Ko, e mbaŋake iyake, thela vethe nasiye inawe o nambo, i thɨn, na thela ma gaithɨ ghaghalithɨ inawe i vakuneŋa ghakwama ghayaboyabo na i vamodo regha.

Kaiwae ya dage e ghemi, Buk Boboma i woraŋgiya iya iŋake, ‘Vambe thɨ govatabova weiyaŋgiya tharɨ gharavakatha,’ iyake ghino utuniŋgu, na bigibigike wolaghɨye Buk Boboma i woraŋgiya ghino kaiwaŋgu emunjoru kaero thɨ yoyomara.”
Gharaghambu thɨ dagewe, thɨŋa, “Giyana, wo u thuwe, gaithɨ ghaghalithɨ munyiwo mathiyake!” I gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Hu viyathu utuutuna iyena!”
Jisas i naŋgo Olivɨ e ghanji Ou
Jisas i raŋgi na i wa Olivɨ e ghanji Ou, ŋgoreiya mbe i vakavakathama na gharaghambuko thɨ ghambu.
Mbaŋa i vutha gheko, i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Hu naŋgo, mbala ma hu ru tanathetha e tɨne.”
I iteteŋgi na le bwagabwaga ŋgoreiya ra du varɨ na ve unjawe, i ronja e gheghe vuvuye na i naŋgo.
Iŋa, “Bwebwe, thoŋgo nuwaniya, u thɨna vuyowoke ghandeghɨ e ghino. Ko iyemaeŋge thava u vakatha ghino lo renuwaŋa, u vakathaeŋge ghen len renuwaŋa.”
Nyao thovuye i mena e buruburu i yomarawe na i vavurɨghegheŋa.
Weiye gharevɨrɨ laghɨye i naŋgo vurɨgheghe na ghaghairo i thɨ dobudobu ŋgoreiya madibe e thelauko vwatae.
Mbaŋa i yondovirɨ naŋgo e ghereiye, i njogha weŋgiya gharaghambu, va thiya ghene sawowori gharevɨrɨ kaiwae.
I dage weŋgi iŋa, “Buda kaiwae huya ghenelaŋa? Hu raka thuweiru na hu naŋgo mbala ma hu ru tanathetha e tɨne.”
Thɨ yalaweya Jisas
Mbaŋa vamba Jisas i utuutu wabwi regha kaero thɨ rakavutha, Judas i viva weŋgi, iye gharaghambu theyaworo na theghewoma regha. I mena na i vandamo Jisas;
ko amba Jisas i dagewe iŋa, “Ko ana u vatomweya Lolo Nariye iya u vandamoke?”
Mbaŋa gharaghambuko va weiyaŋgiko, thɨ thuwe budakaiya ne thɨ vakatha, thɨ vaito thɨŋa, “Giyana, thare valɨkaiwame ne wo vakaiwoŋa lama gaithɨke ghaghalithɨ?”
Regha i mwanavairɨ le gaithɨ ghaghalithɨ kaero i gothethe ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva le rakakaiwo yanawae e uneke.
Ko iyemaeŋge Jisas i dagewe iŋa, “Meiyevarana!” I vɨghathɨgha amalako yanawae na kaero i thawariva.

Amba Jisas i dage weŋgiya ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye, Ŋgolo Boboma gharagatɨgatɨ lenji randevivaŋgi na giyagiya iŋa, “Ko ana mo hu menava weiye lemi gaithɨ ghaghalithɨ na umbwaumbwa uboubotu, hu munjeva rakaivɨ ghino?
Mbaŋako wolaghɨye va weiŋguyaŋgiya ghemi e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne ma hu yalaweŋgo. Ko iyake ghamimbaŋa moli, mbaŋa momouwo le vurɨgheghe i mbaroŋaŋga.”
Pita iŋa ma i ghareghare Jisas
Amba thɨ yalaweya Jisas na thɨ yovaŋgu ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva ele ŋgolo tɨne, na Pita mbe i rereghamba bwagabwaga.
E ŋgoloko ghayayao tɨne, yamoe moli ragatɨgatɨ thɨ rumbwa ndɨghewe na thiya mwa. Pita i ru na i yaku weiyaŋgi.
Amba rakakaiwoko eunda i thuwe Pita i mwamwa ndɨgheko na i njimbughathɨ, amba iŋa, “Mbe ŋgoreiyeva, va weiye Jisas!”
Ko iyemaeŋge Pita i roro iŋa, “Elana, mbema ma ya ghareghare vara iya lolona iyena!”
Mbaŋa ubotu e ghereiye, amala regha i thuwe na iŋa, “Ghen tembe ŋgoreiyeva, ghanjiu regha.” Pita i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Amalana, ma ghino!”
Ŋgoreiya lughawoghawo regha e ghereiye, amala regha i rovurɨgheghe na i utumbele iŋa, “Ma te ghamba numoghegheiwova, amalake iyake va weiye Jisas kaiwae iye rara Galili ŋgoreiya amalaghɨniye.”
Ko iyemaeŋge Pita i gonjoghawe, iŋa, “Amalana, ma ya ghareghare budakai utuniya u utuutuna!” E mbaŋako iyako, vamba i utuutu, kamkam kaero i kula.
Giya i ndevɨ na i njimbughathɨgha Pita. Pita i renuwaŋakikiya Giya ghalɨŋamawe, va iŋama, “Amba muyai kamkam ne i dage, noroke gougou, mbaŋato ne uŋa ma u ghareghareŋgo.”
Pita i raŋgi eto na i randa laghɨye moli.
Thɨ vatabweruŋa Jisas na thɨ ŋgeŋgeŋa
Ghɨmoghɨmoruko va thɨ njimbukikiya Jisas, thɨ vatabweruŋa na thɨ ŋgeŋgeŋa.
Thɨ ŋgarɨgana marae na thɨŋa, “Thoŋgo ghalɨŋae gharauta ghen, u dage weime thela i ŋgeŋgena.”
Na tembe thɨ utuvatharɨweva i ghanagha moli.
Jisas i ndeghathɨ Jiu e lenji kot laghɨye tɨne na i utu
Mbaŋa ighɨviya rakaraka, Jiu e lenji kot laghɨye thɨ mevathavatha weinjiyaŋgiya ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye na mbaro gharavavaghare, amba thɨ vaŋgumena Jisas weŋgi,
thɨ dagewe thɨŋa, “Thoŋgo Mesaiya ghen, u utugiyama weime.” Ko iyemaeŋge Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Thoŋgo ya utugiya weŋga mane hu loŋweghathɨŋgo;
na thoŋgo ya giya vaito weŋga mane hu thombe.
Ko iyemaeŋge e mbaŋake iyake na i ghaoko Lolo Nariye ne i yaku Loi Vurɨgheghe e nɨmaeke uneke.”
Thɨ vaito thɨŋa, “Loi Nariya ghen, ae?” I gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Maiya huŋanani.”
Amba thɨŋa, “Ma te nuwandaiyava gharɨgharɨ vavana thɨ utu kaiwae. Mbe ghinda vara mara loŋwe ghalɨŋae e yanawandake.”
